title: Comparison of clinical outcomes between femtosecond laser-assisted versus conventional phacoemulsification
indication: Age-related cataract (LOCS III NO1-NO4); eyes with corneal scarring, keratoconus, amblyopia, glaucoma, retinal, macular or optic nerve disease excluded; monofocal, toric, multifocal or accommodating IOLs

groups.description: Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery (Victus laser: anterior capsulotomy, lens fragmentation, corneal incisions) followed by phacoemulsification (Infiniti, divide and conquer); single surgeon; retrospective cohort, technique chosen by the patient
Conventional phacoemulsification (2.75 mm temporal clear corneal incision, manual capsulorhexis, Infiniti, divide and conquer), same surgeon

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 10, ECD block) = preoperative ECD (Methods: Konan CellChek XL specular microscopy pre-operatively and at 1 month)
series.notes: Table 10 FLACS 'Mean ± SD' column, rows Baseline and 1 Month under 'ECD (cells/mm2)'; per-visit n from the adjacent FLACS 'n' column.

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 10, ECD block) = preoperative ECD (Methods: Konan CellChek XL specular microscopy pre-operatively and at 1 month)
series.notes: Table 10 CP 'Mean ± SD' column, rows Baseline and 1 Month under 'ECD (cells/mm2)'; per-visit n from the adjacent CP 'n' column.

exclusions.reason: Change from baseline in the eyes with 1-month data; the same table gives absolute ECD for each group and the absolute series is used

exclusions.what: Table 10 corneal oedema and aqueous cells/flare rows; P value column
exclusions.reason: Not endothelial cell density; p-values are not admissible

notes: Role: two established cataract techniques compared without an investigational agent (femtosecond-assisted surgery is listed under the protocol's cataract context); both control-role, separate groups.
The 1-month means come from subsets of the baseline eyes (FLACS 189 of 283, CP 69 of 353); baseline and 1-month means are not restricted to the same eyes.
Table 1 counts 296 FLACS and 439 CP eyes overall; the ECD baseline n is smaller (Table 10).
